walkthroughs.body_html:
On 27 February 1933 the Reichstag burned down — Dutch communist van der Lubbe was blamed.

Hitler used emergency decrees to arrest 4,000 communists. On 23 March 1933 the Enabling Act let him make laws without parliament for four years.

Trade unions were banned in May 1933 and replaced by the German Labour Front.

On 14 July all parties except the Nazis were outlawed. State governments lost power. This process — Gleichschaltung — turned Germany into a one-party state within months.

walkthroughs.h2: Night of Long Knives and Führer
walkthroughs.body_html:
SA leader Ernst Röhm wanted a 'second revolution'. The army hated him.

On 30 June 1934 the SS killed Röhm and rivals in the Night of Long Knives. President Hindenburg died on 2 August. Hitler merged Chancellor and President into one title: Führer. The army swore personal loyalty.
